marine.title: Forecast for Tonight and Wednesday.
marine.text:
Wind northwest 15 knots increasing to northwest 25 near midnight
then diminishing to northwest 15 near noon Wednesday. Wind diminishing to light
early Wednesday evening. Scattered flurries ending Wednesday
morning. Temperatures near minus 9. Over open water freezing spray beginning near midnight and
ending Wednesday afternoon. <br/>

marine.title: Waves for Tonight and Wednesday.
marine.text:
Over open water seas 1 metre or less building to 1 to 2 late
overnight then subsiding to 1 or less Wednesday afternoon.<br/>

marine.title: Extended Forecast
marine.text:
Thursday: Wind light becoming southeast 15 knots in the
 afternoon.<br/>Friday: Wind southeast 15 knots increasing to east
 30.<br/>Saturday: Wind east 30 knots diminishing to light late
 in the day.<br/>
